parameters.jsCode:
const vms = Array.isArray($json.data) ? $json.data : [];
return vms.map(vm => ({ json: { vmid: String(vm.vmid), name: vm.name, node: vm.node, status: vm.status, type: vm.type } }));
return [{ json: { vmid: $json.vmid, name: $json.name, node: $json.node, status: $json.status, type: $json.type, ip: null, ip_source: null, note: 'vm_not_running' } }];
